scope: Opt-in D20 R02 candidate-only runtime bridge and native Windows Player smoke; formal InitialHarbor consumer remains unchanged

checks.name: candidate_resources
checks.evidence: The Unity Editor builder creates a candidate-only prefab with the Visual_player_visual_male_r02 wrapper unpacked, Armature directly under the Animator root, the candidate Animator avatar cleared because the generated clips are generic path clips, and the existing male-peasant outfit rebound onto the same candidate skeleton; formal source assets were not replaced.

checks.name: candidate_outfit_rebind
checks.evidence: The candidate prefab contains 7 skinned renderers: 3 R02 body renderers plus 4 male-peasant outfit renderers path-mapped to the R02 Armature/root. Q03D20CandidateIntegrationPlayModeTests verifies the candidate outfit root and renderer count. This is candidate-only composition; the formal R02 source and InitialHarbor consumer remain unchanged.

checks.name: candidate_root_ownership
checks.evidence: The candidate is a child presentation instance under the D2 physical root; candidate Animator applyRootMotion=false and AlwaysAnimate; Animator.Update does not move the physical root; existing fallback renderers are hidden only inside the opt-in candidate bridge.

checks.name: candidate_action_consumption
checks.evidence: The connected Editor test observed D2-driven Idle, Walk, Run and Board snapshots and verified a generic Walk thigh_l rotation delta; this is a candidate-only generic path adapter, not formal current-rig Humanoid action-quality acceptance.

checks.name: candidate_swimming_presentation_fallback
checks.evidence: The candidate bridge exposes SwimmingVisualSupported=true because the candidate controller contains Fish, maps D2 Swimming to that Fish presentation state, and leaves UnsupportedActionCount at zero on the verified candidate path. This is not a formally authored swimming clip or native swimming proof.

checks.name: native_player_smoke
checks.evidence: The BuildOptions.None Windows Player accepted the bounded real Win32 route in a 1920x1080 client; 45 input steps and 17 screenshots were recorded, the InitialHarbor marker was seen, business interaction proof=true, pause recovery proof=true, fatal_error=null, and the Player closed cleanly.

checks.name: native_candidate_install_markers
checks.evidence: Archived Player log contains '[D20/Candidate] R02 Player visual installed under the D2 physical root; root motion disabled; generic path adapter=True.' and 'command-line candidate installer completed.'

checks.name: native_route_probe_boundary
checks.evidence: The existing D19 route probe did not recognize the new -d19-r03-route-rerun85 flag; probe_exists=false and movement/swimming/ship/far-reject proofs remain false. No route PASS is inferred from screenshots or input attempts.

regression.evidence: Unity Pipeline test_status after the generic candidate bridge recompile; Editor returned to ready/stopped and post-clear error console total=0.

native_smoke.unsupported_candidate_action: The candidate bridge maps D2 Swimming to the existing Fish generic presentation fallback; the latest native route did not observe swimming because the RERUN85 probe was not recognized.

visual_review.evidence: The candidate-only male-peasant outfit rebind improves color and silhouette readability and the generic path adapter consumes the generated clip curves, but the latest native screenshots still show a low-detail raised/T-like action pose, a pale duplicate/fallback figure in the boarding frame, and unresolved port geometry/layering. The screenshots are evidence of the candidate bridge and outfit composition running, not evidence of visual PASS.

formal_boundary.meaning: The opt-in bridge demonstrates a candidate-only generic-path adapter, a bounded Swimming-to-Fish presentation fallback and a native installation marker. It intentionally does not use the R02 Humanoid Avatar at runtime because the generated clips are generic; that adapter is not formal current-rig evidence. It does not make the D20 work asset final, does not provide a formally authored Swimming clip, does not prove continuous native movement/ship observations for RERUN85, and does not resolve the previously reported visual defects.

next_gate: Keep the formal D2 path unchanged. Before any formal Q03 consumer is admitted, provide a current-rig-compatible authored action set or an auditable Avatar/bone-axis adapter, then repeat bounded native movement/boarding/swimming visual review on the exact final candidate build.
